errors.text_span: Категориите са представени по хоризонталната ос
errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart, which means the categories are on the vertical axis and the numerical values are on the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly swaps the axes' roles.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва броя на респондентите и варира от 0 до 20
errors.evidence: The vertical axis shows the categories. The horizontal axis shows the number of respondents and has a scale from 0 to 20. The description has swapped the descriptions of the two axes.

errors.text_span: категориите са подредени по азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The categories are not sorted in alphabetical order. The first letters of the categories are Ц, О, П, Л, О, Р, т, which is not an alphabetical sequence.
The description does not mention the total number of responses (105 responses), which is stated in the figure's title area.
The description fails to mention that the value axis (horizontal) has major tick marks at intervals of 5.
